name: Model G-889 PoC Dual-Antenna Radio
description: High-performance hybrid PoC radio equipped with dual antennas (extended UHF/VHF whip and LTE stubby) for maximum sensitivity and nationwide cellular coverage. Features a full 12-key alphanumeric keypad, vibrant color display, and high-output audio speaker.

name: Model G-F1 Smart PoC Radio
description: Streamlined smart-form PoC handheld radio featuring a high-definition vertical color display and minimalist 3-key navigation. Engineered for rapid dispatch, intuitive group switching, and crystal-clear digital push-to-talk audio.

name: Model G-280-2 Dual-Mode Radio
description: Versatile hybrid communication terminal operating across UHF 400-470MHz at 3W RF power combined with cellular push-to-talk. Features dedicated Call, OK, and End keys, dual top selector dials, and ruggedized housing.

name: Model G-M2 Wearable Clip PoC Radio
description: Ultra-lightweight clip-on wearable PoC transceiver engineered for discreet hospitality, security patrol, and event coordination. Features an oversized tactile central PTT button, digital status screen, and robust belt/lapel clip.

name: Model G-510 Pocket PoC Radio
description: Ergonomic pocket-sized PoC radio built with an integrated low-profile antenna and programmable function key (P1). Designed for all-day frontline operations requiring discreet, dependable push-to-talk connectivity.

name: Model G-H28 Tactical PoC Radio
description: Mission-ready PoC handheld featuring a high-visibility lime-green tactical PTT button, dedicated LED emergency flashlight, full alphanumeric keypad, and reinforced drop-resistant composite body.

name: Model P0 Floating Marine Radio (Tactical Black)
description: Specialized maritime and water-rescue PoC radio engineered with positive buoyancy that floats on water. Features a large 2.4-inch display, sealed acoustic chamber, and IP68 waterproof submersible construction in Tactical Black.

name: Model P0-Ex Floating Marine Radio (ATEX Blue Edition)
description: Certified explosion-proof (Ex) intrinsically safe edition of the P0 floating radio. Finished in high-visibility safety marine blue, designed for oil & gas refineries, chemical handling, offshore rigs, and maritime fleets.

name: G-TECH Vehicle-PoC Mobile Transceiver
description: Heavy-duty mobile PoC vehicle transceiver for fleet trucks, emergency apparatus, security patrols, and commercial transport. Features a heavy-duty palm microphone, backlit SOS & dispatch keys, external vehicle antenna port, and dashboard mounting bracket.

name: G-TECH Digital Armor Dual-Knob Radio
description: Ruggedized dual-knob digital radio available in Tactical Black and Military Olive Green armor. Engineered with dedicated top rotary channel and volume dials, an instant front SOS alarm button, and reinforced shock-absorbing exoskeleton.

name: G-TECH Tri-Mode Hybrid PoC + DMR Radio
description: True multi-mission hybrid transceiver combining conventional VHF/UHF direct RF frequency communication with unlimited nationwide 4G LTE PoC. Features dual dedicated antennas (UV whip + LTE stub), A/B dual-channel monitoring, and a full tactical DTMF keypad.

name: G-TECH Long-Range Command PoC + VHF/UHF Radio

name: G-TECH Global LTE Tactical Radio
